name: forge
description: Forge - a method layer for complex recurring work and code on top of Claude Code / Cowork: interview -> plan -> orders with DoD and a quality bar -> execution by the cheapest fitting actor -> two-family verification with evidence -> lessons that become guards. Claude leads (DoD, plan, architecture, judgement); executors are chosen by both plans' limits (Codex CLI in patch mode or Claude agents); Ollama does free grunt work. Autonomous runs, a compaction handoff, behavioural evals, a native swarm workflow, the code canon, Serena + Context7, deterministic code checks, a progress band. Skills map routes every domain to one primary skill per stage.
